before: In a temporary synthetic case, an evidence item describing only temperature, without metric_key, unit or value, could support an indicator for waste_mass in kg. The simulated assessment reached validate.ready=true with verdict cumplido.
After requiring a typed measurement, scope missing or blank still allowed simulated cumplido and incumplido because the matching evidence selection did not check it.
An observed evidence item with a whitespace, numeric or object method still passed the general evidence gate and could support either decisive simulated verdict.

after.indicator_requirement: Each criterion indicator needs a current, unchallenged evidence measurement in its own ancestry with matching explicit metric_key and unit, numeric value, nonblank textual scope and a valid protocol path to the normative problem.
after.observed_method_requirement: Observed evidence requires a nonblank textual collection method.
after.provisional_evidence: Untyped evidence can remain provisional during study/specify and no_demostrado remains available; it cannot alone support a decisive verdict.
after.historical_ledgers: Existing versioned ledger bytes and the synthetic_multiagent no_demostrado acceptance were retained.

verification.focused_command: uv run pytest -q tests/test_method.py tests/test_field_attestation.py tests/test_injection_bank.py
verification.independent_review: Reproduced rejection of missing, blank, whitespace and nontextual scopes and invalid observed methods for both decisive verdicts; valid method and no_demostrado controls passed. Final review reported no remaining finding in scope.

limits: The tests and decisive verdicts in the reproducer use synthetic data.
A typed, scoped, protocol-linked local evidence item is not an authenticated measurement or independent source verification.
A real signed field success still needs external custody, competent approval, causal analysis and observed outcomes.
